maintenance_led.reason: Sells FDA-approved kidney disease drugs (Auryxia, Vafseo) to patients; new prescriptions, not repair or servicing of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Auryxia and Vafseo are used largely by dialysis and CKD patients, mostly covered by Medicare and Medicaid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own drug development and commercialization; Keryx merger was a single large deal.

mission_critical.reason: Prescription kidney therapies; switching needs physician decision, carries clinical risk, and the drugs are regulator-approved.

notes: Payer mix is inferred from my knowledge of its dialysis-focused products, not from the website text.
